canonical_name: TerraLingua -- Emergence and Analysis of Open-endedness in LLM Ecologies (Paolo et al., Cognizant AI Lab, 2026)
lineage: LLM-agent ecology (2026) with a post-hoc LLM annotation pipeline; sibling of OpenLife (ALIFE 2026) and Conversable Complexity (2026)
dependencies: an LLM API (anthropic / openai clients) for the agents and for the AI Anthropologist
entry_points: analysis_scripts/001..006 (the AI Anthropologist; 006_artifact_philogeny.py = artifact ancestry by text match or LLM inference)

example.input: an experiment's agent logs + artifacts.json (see terralingua-data-abundant-exp-1)
example.output: artifact ancestry edges with relationship type and model confidence

environment.note: analysis scripts are pure Python; the LLM arm needs an API key and spend (operator decision)

human_capability_summary.built_to: run a persistent multi-agent LLM ecology and reconstruct its cultural history afterwards
human_capability_summary.pressure: understanding coordination, institutions and culture in agent populations
human_capability_summary.success_means: cooperative norms, division of labour and branching artifact lineages observed and annotated

known_human_problem_solved: post-hoc reconstruction of cultural ancestry in an LLM ecology (inference, not recorded provenance -- MEASURED 2026-09-17)
behavioral_entry_point: 006_artifact_philogeny.py with BYNARY/LLM_PHYLOGENY toggles: method 1 (text match) vs method 2 (LLM) on the same experiment

runtime.host_class: any Python 3 host for the deterministic analysis; LLM arms need network + keys

preservation.note: status is the worse of body_status and the recipe axis; a matching tree hash alone never implies completeness.
